title: The Forge Sings
text: The smith says the iron hums when it cools, a low sweet note like a woman singing far away, and will not stop. He has not slept in days. He stands at the anvil with his eyes shut, his lips moving, and the blades he makes now are very fine.

options.label: Let the smith follow the song.

outcomes.text: What comes off the anvil is beautiful and wrong.
The smith hammers for three days and nights and remembers none of it.

options.label: Quench the forge for a season.
